prompt: Who was the first Tunisian president to be elected by universal suffrage after the 2011 revolution?
answer: Beji Caid Essebsi was the first Tunisian president elected by universal suffrage after the 2011 revolution. He won the 2014 presidential election and took office on December 31, 2014.
